method: We kept zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifiers certified as connected-capable (network control) and compared those with the highest smoke CADR, weighing smoke CADR and the five-year electricity cost (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). Every model tied with the last one on the selection criterion is listed, so the cut never picks among equals.
name: Best smart Wi-Fi air purifiers, ranked by certified data
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100
